title: perf(plugin-detail,app-shell): the record page's related column loads counts first, then rows only for the cards in view, and never blocks the details
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu4U7UrS1BhTKoR1NK6q6Qvx)_
Fixes #27056

Clause-②: yes (widening: three new exports on the published `@object-ui/plugin-detail` main entry, a public-surface addition; no accept set moves)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录页右侧关联列改为分步加载。打开记录时,所有关联卡的计数作为一组请求一起发出(每个只取总数和 1 条 id),到齐前卡片是占位;计数为 0 的卡只剩标题行,不取行;有数的卡进入视口(下方 200 px 内也算)才取前 3 行,只取名称字段加一个状态或日期字段;关掉时间线后折叠的「动态」卡打开前什么都不读;抽屉里 ↑ ↓ 会预取下一条记录的计数。
- 为什么改:落实裁决「关联都放在右侧,记录打开时是不是会很慢」。原来打开记录时每个子表各取 5 行、带一串 populate,和记录本身的读取抢时间。
- 风险与回滚:只改 plugin-detail 和 app-shell 前端的读取顺序,不动协议和服务端。计数失败的卡回到自己取行,没有 IntersectionObserver 的环境立即取行,两种都有测试。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。新增三个导出(Clause-② yes),纯增量。
- 先看:① `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/useRelatedCounts.ts` 里的 `useRelatedCounts`(一组计数、统一占位、在 transition 里放行卡片);② `RelatedList.tsx` 的 compact 分支(`rowsWanted`、`compactSelect`、`countAnswers`);③ `app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerStack.tsx` 的 `PrefetchUpcomingRelatedCounts`。
- 两分钟验证:在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.relatedCountsFirst-27056.test.tsx`。预期 2 个测试通过:6 个关联列表先一起发 6 个计数,之后只有视口内且有数的 2 张卡各取 3 行。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The record page's related column (the column tiers, from 1024 px) loads in steps, and the details column never waits for it.

- **Counts first** (`useRelatedCounts`, new). `RelatedCardStack` counts every card it places in one request set, sent beside the record read through the existing count store (`RelatedCountStore`, the store the tab badges read, invalidated by the data-change bus). Each probe asks for the total and one row's `id` (`top=1&select=id` on the wire). Every card shows one placeholder (`data-related-card-pending`) until the whole set has answered, so there is one loading state. The faces then mount in a React transition: a record read that lands at the same moment renders the details first. A card counted at 0 folds to its title row and never reads rows. A failed count leaves its card to read for itself, as before.
- **Rows on demand** (`RelatedList`, compact branch). A card reads at most three rows, in its inherited sort. It asks only for `id`, the name field (declared or derived) and one chip field. The chip field comes from the authored `relatedListColumns` when they are declared, else the object's status field, else its first date field. A card reads only once it has been in view (`useSeenOnce`, an `IntersectionObserver` latch, `rootMargin` 200 px below the fold). While the count answers a card, its header draws from that count. The folded 「动态」 card (timeline switched off) is closed until opened, and its feed is not mounted until then.
- **Details first.** The details column renders from the record read alone. The related column's placeholders hold their place until the counts land.
- **Prefetch on step** (`recordDrawerStack`). The drawer works out the record that ↑ / ↓ would show next. Once the current record has loaded, `PrefetchUpcomingRelatedCounts` warms that record's counts (`relatedCountTargetsIn` over the page drawn now), so the next page's cards draw their counts from the store.
- **Shape stays independent of the card face.** `useRelatedCounts` returns per-card states (`pending` / `counted` / `uncounted`). The card face is not part of that shape, so #27524 can read the same hook.

Additive API: `prefetchRelatedCounts`, `relatedCountTargetsIn`, `relatedCountTargetOf` and the types `RelatedCountTarget` and `RelatedCountsSource` are exported for the drawer prefetch. `RecordPageColumns` also takes an optional `relatedFieldsOf`, which lets the host pass the child field definitions it already holds so the counts read no schema first.

## Tests

- `app-shell/.../RecordDetailView.relatedCountsFirst-27056.test.tsx` renders the real page at 1440 px over a data source that holds every related read, for a record with 6 related lists:
  - The details (name, highlight, details column) draw while every related read is still out, with 6 placeholders.
  - The 6 counts go out as one set before any answers, with no row read.
  - After they answer, rows are read only for the 2 counted cards in view (`$top` 3, `$select ['id','name','status']`). Nothing is read for the 0-count card in view or for the 3 cards below the fold. That is 8 reads in total, in 2 round trips.
- `plugin-detail/.../useRelatedCounts-27056.test.tsx` (8 tests):
  - one request set with id-only probes
  - one loading state until all answer
  - the store filling up does not release a first set
  - stepping back to a settled record draws its counts at once, with no placeholder flash
  - a failed count leaves its card uncounted
  - no source counts nothing
  - a prefetched parent draws on its first render with no read
  - a declared scope is resolved
  - the `relatedCountTargetsIn` walk skips gated and bound nodes
- `plugin-detail/.../RelatedList.compactLazy-27056.test.tsx`:
  - a 0-count card never queries rows and reports itself empty
  - a card out of view holds 3 row placeholders and reads nothing
  - a card in view reads `$top` 3, `$skip` 0 with the projection
  - without `IntersectionObserver` the card reads at once
- `app-shell/.../recordDrawerStack.prefetch-27056.test.tsx`: the next record follows the step direction, and the prefetch fires only once the current record is ready and the object matches.
- `RecordPageColumns.switches-27052.test.tsx`: updated so that the folded 「动态」 card starts closed with nothing mounted, and opening it mounts the feed.

Ablations, each run against the tests above:

| Ablation | Result |
|---|---|
| `stateOf` forced to `uncounted` | 2 acceptance tests fail |
| `useSeenOnce` forced to `true` | 3 tests fail |
| the first-ask rule dropped | "the store answering is not the set settling" fails |
| the settled-parent clear dropped | "stepping back" fails |

## Acceptance notes

- **"One counts call"** is one request set. There is no batched read door on `main` (`/batch` takes writes only), and adding one is a server and protocol change outside this card. The set is N `$count` probes of one id each, all sent together before any answers, behind one loading state. On HotCRM they go out within 8 ms of each other, in parallel with the record read (waterfall below).
- **"Primary cards first."** On the synthesized page the primary lists are body tables in the details column, so the related column holds no primary cards. Its cards are counted and read in page order, and only the ones in view read rows.
- **Request count vs round trips.** On HotCRM a cold open sends 14–16 related requests where `main` sent 10, in the same 2 round trips. Each count carries one id, and each row read carries 3 projected rows. On `main` each read carried 5 rows with up to 9 populated lookups. The trade-off is that a card's first rows land 260–380 ms after the record read (the last card's by 330–490 ms), where on `main` they landed before it. Meanwhile each card shows its count in its header.
- **Details time** is dominated by one render of the page when the record lands: a single 100–200 ms long task on both builds (`longtask` entries). The transition keeps the card faces out of that render. Without it, Acme measured 302–312 ms on this branch, where the faces had mounted just before the record landed.

## Verification

### Budget (HotCRM, measured)

| Budget | Target | `main` (6892888e) | this PR | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Details interactive, after the record read returns | ≤ 300 ms | median 189 ms, max 326 ms (2 of 12 opens over) | median 217 ms, max 260 ms (0 of 12 over) | ✅ |
| All card headers drawn, after the record read returns | ≤ 500 ms | median −20 ms, max 28 ms (the headers come from the 5-row reads) | median 181 ms, max 235 ms (the headers come from the counts, after the details) | ✅ |
| Related round trips on open | ≤ 2 | 2: 9 row reads, then a lookup-label read | 2: 9 counts, then 5–7 three-row reads | ✅ |
| Related requests on open | — | 10 | 16 / 15 / 16 at 1600×1000; 14 at 1600×700 (fewer cards in view) | |

<details><summary>How it was measured</summary>

- **Backend.** HotCRM on a fresh DB (`objectstack dev --fresh`). The `crm_account` record page has 9 related lists in the related column: contacts, contracts, quotes, child accounts, events, leads, opportunities, tasks and cases.
- **Console.** Production builds (`vite build`) of `main` at 6892888e and of this branch, served by `vite preview`, which proxies to the backend. Measured in headless Chromium at 1600×1000 (the three-column tier) and once at 1600×700.
- **Opens.** A warm-up open of a fourth account (Wayne) first, so modules and metadata are loaded, as for a reader arriving from the list. Then an SPA navigation to each of Acme, Globex and Stark. Three alternating `main`/branch rounds plus the 700 px round give 12 opens per build.
- **Numbers.** Every number comes from the Resource Timing entries (the entries DevTools' network panel draws), relative to the `responseEnd` of the record read.
  - "Details interactive": the details column shows the record's phone and the main thread has run a task after the next frame.
  - "Headers": every card in the related column is past its placeholder and loading state.
  - "Round trip": a related read that went out after an earlier related response had landed starts a new round.

| Account | `main` details ms (3 rounds · 700 px) | this PR details ms | this PR headers ms | this PR requests (counts + rows) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Acme | 303 / 195 / 188 · 326 | 197 / 237 / 227 · 198 | 178 / 212 / 204 · 176 | 9+7 · 9+5 |
| Globex | 170 / 232 / 162 · 177 | 215 / 219 / 215 · 225 | 30 / 194 / 196 · 31 | 9+6 · 9+5 |
| Stark | 130 / 189 / 195 · 179 | 260 / 205 / 114 · 232 | 183 / 121 / 235 · 37 | 9+7 · 9+5 |

</details>
